# Levit Web Editor (llms.txt)
> A modern, zero-dependency, AI-ready hybrid web editor for effortless embedding and extensibility.

## Overview
Levit is a web editor library designed from scratch using standard Web APIs (DOM, Selection, InputEvent) with 0 runtime external dependencies. It combines block-based navigation (Notion style) with smooth rich-text editing (Tiptap style), live markdown shortcuts, floating bubble toolbars, slash commands (`/`), and built-in AI response streaming.

## 1. Quick Start

### Web Component (<levit-editor>)
```html
<script type="module" src="https://unpkg.com/@yonailab/levit/dist/index.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@yonailab/levit/dist/levit.css">

<levit-editor placeholder="Type something or press '/'..."></levit-editor>

<script>
  const editorEl = document.querySelector('levit-editor');
  editorEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    console.log('JSON:', e.detail.json);
    console.log('Text:', e.detail.text);
  });
</script>
```
The element adds the bubble and slash menus (`bubble-menu="false"` /
`slash-menu="false"` leave them out). Attributes: `placeholder`, `lang` (ko/ja;
a later change rebuilds the editor with the same document), `theme`
(dark/light), `value` (initial JSON). Methods: getJSON(), setJSON(), getText(),
focus(); `el.editor` is the full LevitEditor. Moving the element keeps its document.

### Vanilla JavaScript / TypeScript
```ts
import { createLevitEditor, createBubbleMenu, createSlashMenu } from '@yonailab/levit';
import '@yonailab/levit/levit.css';

const container = document.getElementById('editor');
const editor = createLevitEditor(container, {
  placeholder: 'Write your story...',
  onChange: (ed) => console.log(ed.getJSON()),
});

// Attach modern menus
createBubbleMenu(editor);
createSlashMenu(editor);   // "/" at the start of a line or after a space; typing after it filters
```

## 2. Document Data Schema (JSON)
```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "id": "b_1",
      "type": "heading",
      "attrs": { "level": 1 },
      "content": [{ "text": "Hello Levit", "marks": [] }]
    },
    {
      "id": "b_2",
      "type": "paragraph",
      "attrs": {},
      "content": [
        { "text": "This is ", "marks": [] },
        { "text": "bold", "marks": [{ "type": "bold" }] },
        { "text": " text.", "marks": [] }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Block types
`paragraph`, `heading` (`attrs.level` 1-6), `blockquote`,
`code_block` (optional `attrs.language`, e.g. `"ts"`),
`bullet_list_item`, `ordered_list_item`, `task_list_item` (`attrs.checked`: boolean),
`horizontal_rule`, `image` (`attrs.src`, `attrs.alt`).
Lists are flat: each list item is its own block, and consecutive items of the
same type form one list (exported as one `<ul>`/`<ol>` or one Markdown list).
Nesting is `attrs.indent` (0-8, omitted at the top level) on list items; an
item is at most one level deeper than the item above it.
`horizontal_rule` and `image` have no text (`content: [{ "text": "" }]`) and the
caret never goes inside them. Image `src` must be `http:`, `https:`, `blob:`,
relative, or a bitmap `data:image/...` URL (no SVG).

```json
[
  { "type": "bullet_list_item", "content": [{ "text": "Fruits" }] },
  { "type": "bullet_list_item", "attrs": { "indent": 1 }, "content": [{ "text": "Apple" }] },
  { "type": "task_list_item", "attrs": { "checked": true }, "content": [{ "text": "Buy milk" }] },
  { "type": "horizontal_rule", "content": [{ "text": "" }] },
  { "type": "image", "attrs": { "src": "https://example.com/a.png", "alt": "A" }, "content": [{ "text": "" }] },
  { "type": "code_block", "attrs": { "language": "ts" }, "content": [{ "text": "const a = 1;" }] }
]
```

### Marks
`bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `highlight`, `code`, `link` (`attrs.href`).
Link hrefs must be `http:`, `https:`, `mailto:` or relative; anything else
(e.g. `javascript:`) is dropped on render, import and export.

### Markdown shortcuts (typed at the start of a block)
`# ` to `###### ` heading, `> ` quote, ``` code block, `- ` or `* ` bulleted
list, `1. ` numbered list, `[] ` / `[ ] ` / `[x] ` task (also after `- `),
`---` divider. Shortcuts do not apply inside code blocks.

### Keys and line breaks
- `Enter` splits the block; `Shift+Enter` inserts a line break inside the block.
  Line breaks are stored as `"\n"` in the text (HTML `<br>`, Markdown `\` at line end).
- `Backspace` / `Delete` remove one whole character (emoji included).
  `Alt+Backspace` (macOS) or `Ctrl+Backspace` deletes a word; `Cmd+Backspace` (macOS) deletes to the line start.
- `Cmd/Ctrl+B`, `I`, `U` toggle bold, italic, underline. `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+X` toggles
  strikethrough and `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+H` highlight. `Cmd/Ctrl+Z` undo, `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z` or `Ctrl+Y` redo.
- In a list item, `Tab` nests it one level and `Shift+Tab` moves it back up
  (outside lists, Tab keeps moving focus). Enter on an empty nested item or
  Backspace at its start moves it up a level first.
- `Cmd/Ctrl+Enter` checks or unchecks the task at the caret; clicking the box does too.
- Backspace at the start of the block after an image or divider removes it;
  Delete at the end of the block before one does too.
- `Cmd/Ctrl+A` selects the whole document.
- Clicking a code block's language label (top right) asks for a new language.

### Paste, copy and drop
Every edit goes through the document model; the editor cancels the browser's
own DOM changes. Paste reads HTML first (web pages, Google Docs), then
multi-line Markdown, then plain text (one paragraph per line). Inside a code
block, paste inserts plain text. Copy/cut write Levit HTML plus plain text.
Text dropped from outside is inserted at the drop point; drag-moving text
inside the editor is not supported yet. DOM changes made by scripts or
extensions are rolled back from the model.

## 3. Serializers & Formats
- `documentToJSON(doc)` / `documentFromJSON(json)`: Clean, deterministic block JSON
- `documentToMarkdown(doc)` / `markdownToDocument(markdown)`: Lossless Markdown
- `documentToHTML(doc)` / `htmlToDocument(html)`: Semantic HTML

Nested lists become nested `<ul>`/`<ol>` and Markdown lists indented under
their parent. Tasks are `- [ ] text` / `- [x] text` in Markdown and
`<li data-checked><input type="checkbox">` in HTML. Highlight is `==text==` /
`<mark>`, dividers `---` / `<hr>`, images `![alt](src)` / `<img>`, and code
languages ```` ```ts ```` / `<code class="language-ts">`.

## 4. Chained Command API
```ts
editor.chain()
  .insertText('Hello')
  .toggleBold()
  .setHeading(2)
  .run();

editor.chain().setBlockType('bullet_list_item').run();
editor.chain().insertLineBreak().run();        // same as Shift+Enter
editor.chain().deleteForward().run();          // also deleteWordBackward/Forward, deleteLineBackward/Forward
editor.chain().insertFragment(blocks).run();   // insert blocks at the caret, like a paste
editor.chain().setLink('https://example.com').run(); // applies to the selection
editor.chain().unsetLink().run();
editor.getActiveLink(); // href of the selected link, or null

editor.chain().indentListItem().run();         // Tab; outdentListItem() is Shift+Tab
editor.chain().setBlockType('task_list_item', { checked: false }).run();
editor.chain().toggleTaskChecked().run();      // or toggleTaskChecked(blockId)
editor.chain().toggleStrike().run();
editor.chain().toggleHighlight().run();
editor.chain().insertHorizontalRule().run();
editor.chain().insertImage({ src: 'https://example.com/a.png', alt: 'A' }).run();
editor.chain().setCodeBlock('ts').run();       // setCodeLanguage('py') changes it, '' clears it
editor.chain().selectAll().run();
```

### Editor options
```ts
createLevitEditor(container, {
  initialContent: savedJSON,   // the document to start with (JSON); empty by default
  placeholder: 'Write...',
  onChange: (editor) => {},
  onSelectionChange: (selection) => {},
  // Pasted and dropped image files are uploaded with this, then inserted.
  // Without it, image files are ignored. Images go in one by one, in order.
  uploadImage: async (file) => 'https://cdn.example.com/a.png',
  // Errors from background work, such as a failed upload.
  onError: (error) => console.error(error),
  // Highlights code blocks that have a language. Return HTML for the code;
  // only <span class style> is kept and the text must not change.
  highlightCode: (code, language) => code,
  plugins: [],      // see "6. Plugins"
  messages: ko,     // see "8. Messages"; English by default
});
```

### Other editor methods
```ts
editor.getJSON(); editor.setJSON(json); editor.getText();
editor.getHTML(); editor.getMarkdown();   // include plugin blocks and marks
editor.isActive('bold');                  // all selected text has the mark (or the next typed text will)
editor.getActiveLink();                   // href of the selected link, or null
editor.undo(); editor.redo(); editor.focus(); editor.destroy();
editor.setEditable(false); editor.isEditable;   // lock or unlock typing
editor.replaceState(state);   // e.g. state built from an older one, to undo many changes in one step
editor.reportError(error);    // to onError, or the console
```

## 5. AI (import from '@yonailab/levit/ai')
A separate entry point, so editors without AI do not load it. Levit never
calls an AI service: you pass a provider that returns the answer as a stream
of Markdown text.

```ts
import { aiPlugin, runAICommand, stopAI, streamMarkdown, getDocumentSchema, validateDocument } from '@yonailab/levit/ai';

interface AIRequest {
  command: string;      // 'improve' | 'continue' | 'summarize' | your own id
  prompt: string;       // instructions for the model
  text: string;         // Markdown of the selection (whole document for summarize without one)
  before: string;       // Markdown before the selection/caret (contextLength chars, default 4000)
  after: string;        // Markdown after it
  signal: AbortSignal;  // aborted on Escape or stopAI(editor)
}

createLevitEditor(el, {
  plugins: [
    aiPlugin({
      provider: (request: AIRequest) => asyncIterableOfStrings, // or a Promise of one
      commands: [{ id: 'translate', title: 'Translate', prompt: 'Translate to English.', insert: 'replace', needsSelection: true }],
      suggestions: true,     // 'replace' answers become suggestions (default true)
      contextLength: 4000,
    }),
  ],
});

await runAICommand(editor, 'improve');                      // { markdown, aborted } or null without a selection
await runAICommand(editor, 'continue', { prompt: '...' });  // one-off prompt
stopAI(editor);
```
Built-in commands: `improve` (replace the selection, as a suggestion; also a
bubble menu button), `continue` (write at the caret), `summarize` (new block
below the selection, or summarize the whole document). AICommand.insert is
'replace' | 'cursor' | 'below'. Menu titles come from editor.messages
(aiImprove, aiContinue, aiSummarize...). One command runs at a time; editing
is locked meanwhile (contenteditable=false, aria-busy).

Suggestions use plugin marks `suggestion_insert` (<ins>) and
`suggestion_delete` (<del>) with attrs { id, join? }. Accept or reject with
the floating toolbar, `Mod-Shift-Enter` / `Mod-Shift-Backspace`, or
`editor.commands.acceptSuggestions(id?)` / `rejectSuggestions(id?)` (return
false when there is nothing to resolve or an answer is still streaming).
HTML export shows <del>/<ins>; Markdown export reads as if accepted.

`streamMarkdown(editor, stream, { signal, at: 'selection' | 'below', insert })`
streams Markdown into the editor with live formatting (unclosed **bold**,
code fences... shown as closed meanwhile), undone in one step.

`getDocumentSchema({ plugins })` returns the JSON Schema (2020-12) of a
document; the built-in one ships as `@yonailab/levit/document.schema.json`.
Use it as a structured-output or tool schema so a model writes Levit JSON.
`validateDocument(json, { plugins })` returns { valid, errors: [{ path, message }] }
and also refuses unsafe link and image URLs. Plugins can describe their attrs
with `attrsSchema` on BlockSpec and MarkSpec.

Older helpers, still in the main entry: `getAIContext(editor)` (documentText,
selectedText, blockCount, currentBlockType, summary) and
`streamAIResponse(editor, stream)` (inserts text as typed, no formatting).

## 6. Plugins
A plugin is a plain object. Pass plugins as `createLevitEditor(el, { plugins: [...] })`.
Plugins may not redefine built-in block or mark types, or each other's.

```ts
import type { LevitPlugin } from '@yonailab/levit';

const plugin: LevitPlugin = {
  name: 'example',
  blocks: [
    {
      type: 'callout',              // editable block with text
      tag: 'aside',                 // element, default 'div'
      className: 'my-callout',
      toHTML: (block, content) => `<aside class="callout">${content}</aside>`,
      toMarkdown: (block, text) => `> [!NOTE]\n> ${text}`,
      parseHTML: (el) => (el.matches('aside.callout') ? {} : null),       // attrs, or null to skip
      parseMarkdown: (raw) => (raw.startsWith('> [!NOTE]') ? { text: raw.slice(12) } : null),
    },
    {
      type: 'video',
      atom: true,                   // no text, like an image: caret skips it, Backspace after it removes it
      render: (block, el) => { /* draw into el (non-editable) */ },
      toHTML: (block) => `<div data-video="${block.attrs?.id}"></div>`,
      parseHTML: (el) => (el.hasAttribute('data-video') ? { id: el.getAttribute('data-video') } : null),
    },
  ],
  marks: [
    {
      type: 'color',
      tag: 'span',
      attributes: (mark) => ({ style: `color: ${mark.attrs?.color}` }),  // on* attributes are dropped
      toHTML: (text, mark) => `<span style="color: ${mark.attrs?.color}">${text}</span>`,
      inclusive: false,   // text typed right after it does not get the mark (default true)
      parseHTML: (el) => ((el as HTMLElement).style.color ? { color: (el as HTMLElement).style.color } : null),
    },
  ],
  // Command factories: arguments in, a change to the transaction out (return false to cancel).
  commands: {
    insertVideo: (id: string) => (tr) => void tr.insertAtom('video', { id }),
  },
  // 'Mod' is Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere. Return false to let the built-in key run.
  keymap: { 'Mod-Shift-v': (editor) => editor.commands.insertVideo('intro') },
  // Typed at the start of a block; checked before the built-in rules.
  inputRules: [{ match: /^!!!\s$/, handler: (tr, match, blockId) => { /* change tr */ return true; } }],
  slashItems: [{ id: 'video', title: 'Video', description: 'Embed a video', icon: '🎬',
    action: (editor) => editor.commands.insertVideo('intro') }],
  // Bubble menu buttons. Titles (here and in slashItems) may be (editor) => string.
  bubbleItems: [{ label: '🎬', title: (editor) => 'Video', action: (editor) => {} }],
  setup: (editor) => () => { /* cleanup on destroy */ },
};

editor.commands.insertVideo('v1');                      // runs at once, returns true unless cancelled
editor.chain().exec('insertVideo', 'v1').insertText('caption').run();
documentToHTML(doc, { plugins }); htmlToDocument(html, { plugins });   // serializers take plugins too
documentToMarkdown(doc, { plugins }); markdownToDocument(md, { plugins });
```
Without the plugin, unknown blocks export as plain paragraphs of their text (or nothing if empty).

Blocks in the document are frozen and shared between states and undo history, so a
block that a change does not touch stays the same object. To change a block in a
command or input rule, get a copy the transaction owns:
```ts
const block = tr.editBlock(blockId);   // or an index; undefined if missing
if (block) block.attrs = { ...block.attrs, color: 'red' };
// tr.doc.blocks[i].attrs = ...  throws: the block is frozen
```

## 7. Events
```ts
const stop = editor.on('update', ({ editor, transaction }) => {});   // document changed (also undo/redo/setJSON)
editor.on('selectionUpdate', ({ editor, selection }) => {});
editor.on('transaction', ({ editor, transaction }) => {});           // every dispatch
editor.on('focus', ({ event }) => {}); editor.on('blur', ({ event }) => {});
editor.on('destroy', ({ editor }) => {});
stop();                       // or editor.off(name, handler)
```
A handler that throws does not stop the others; the error goes to `onError` (or the console).

## 8. Messages and accessibility
```ts
import { ko, ja, en } from '@yonailab/levit';
createLevitEditor(el, { messages: ko });                // Korean menus, prompts and labels (ja: Japanese)
createLevitEditor(el, { messages: { bold: 'Gras' } });  // override some messages
editor.t('codeLanguageLabel', { language: 'ts' });      // a message with {placeholders} filled
```
`<levit-editor lang="ko">` uses Korean, `lang="ja"` Japanese. The editor element is `role="textbox"`
with `aria-multiline` and an `aria-label` (unless the page names it). The slash
menu is a `listbox` the editor points at with `aria-activedescendant`. The
bubble menu is a `toolbar`: `Alt+F10` moves focus to it from selected text,
arrows/Home/End move between buttons, Enter or Space presses one, Escape
returns to the text, and `aria-pressed` says which formats are on. In a code
block (collapsed caret) `Alt+F10` focuses the language label instead: Enter or
Space asks for a language, Escape returns to the code.

## 9. Theming
Every color is a CSS variable (`--levit-bg`, `--levit-surface`, `--levit-border`,
`--levit-text`, `--levit-text-muted`, `--levit-placeholder`, `--levit-primary`,
`--levit-primary-hover`, `--levit-on-primary`, `--levit-selection`, `--levit-highlight`,
`--levit-code-bg`, `--levit-code-text`, `--levit-quote-border`, `--levit-danger`,
comments: `--levit-comment-bg`, `--levit-comment-active-bg`, `--levit-comment-border`,
AI suggestions: `--levit-suggestion-insert-bg`, `--levit-suggestion-insert-text`,
`--levit-suggestion-delete-text`), plus `--levit-font-sans`, `--levit-font-mono`,
`--levit-radius`, `--levit-shadow`.
Dark mode: `[data-theme="dark"]`, or the system setting unless `[data-theme="light"]`.

## 10. React and Vue
```bash
npm install @yonailab/levit @yonailab/levit-react   # React 18/19
npm install @yonailab/levit @yonailab/levit-vue     # Vue 3
```
```tsx
import { LevitEditor, useLevitEditor } from '@yonailab/levit-react';
<LevitEditor value={doc} onChange={(json, editor) => setDoc(json)} messages={ko} plugins={[plugin]} />
<LevitEditor defaultValue={doc} ref={editorRef} onReady={(editor) => {}} bubbleMenu={false} />
const { ref, editor } = useLevitEditor({ placeholder: 'Write' });   // <div ref={ref} />
```
```vue
<LevitEditor v-model="doc" :messages="ko" @ready="(editor) => {}" @error="(e) => {}" />
<!-- const { element, editor } = useLevitEditor(options)  →  <div ref="element" /> -->
```
Both add the bubble and slash menus unless turned off, and a value that comes
back from onChange / v-model does not reset the caret. The React package is
marked 'use client'.

## 11. Collaboration (Yjs) and comments
```bash
npm install @yonailab/levit @yonailab/levit-yjs yjs   # yjs is a peer; the core has no dependencies
```
```ts
import * as Y from 'yjs';
import { bindYjs, type AwarenessLike } from '@yonailab/levit-yjs';

// Bind after the provider has loaded the shared doc: an empty array gets the
// editor's document, otherwise the editor shows the shared one.
const binding = bindYjs(editor, ydoc.getArray('blocks'), {
  awareness: provider.awareness,                 // optional: shares carets (AwarenessLike)
  user: { name: 'Mina', color: '#e11d48' },      // how others see this user
  captureTimeout: 500,                           // undo groups changes within this time
});
binding.remoteCursors();       // [{ id, name, color, anchor, head }] of the others
binding.undoManager;           // Y.UndoManager: undo/redo (and the keys) undo only this user's changes
binding.destroy();             // stop syncing; undo goes back to the editor's history
```
Shared structure: Y.Array of Y.Map blocks { id, type, attrs (object), text (Y.Text) };
marks are Y.Text formatting ({ bold: true }, { link: { href } }, { comment: { ids } }).
Changes from others keep the caret on the same character (Yjs relative
positions) and wait while an IME composes text.

Without Yjs, draw carets you share some other way:
```ts
const cursors = createRemoteCursors(editor);   // layer after the editor, aria-hidden
cursors.set([{ id: 'u1', name: 'Mina', color: '#e11d48', anchor: pos, head: pos }]);
cursors.destroy();                             // also removed with the editor
```
Names are shown as text; colors that are not plain CSS colors become gray.

Core hooks for other bindings:
```ts
tr.setMeta('addToHistory', false);   // keep a change out of undo
tr.setMeta('remote', true);          // a change from elsewhere: does not take focus/selection when unfocused
tr.getMeta(key);                     // read meta in editor.on('transaction', ...)
tr.setBlocks(blocks);                // replace all blocks; pass unchanged ones as they are
editor.setHistory({ undo: () => boolean, redo: () => boolean });   // or null for the built-in history
editor.isComposing;                  // true during IME composition: wait with remote changes
editor.hasFocus();
```

Comments: the editor keeps where they are, the app keeps the threads by id.
```ts
import { commentsPlugin, getComments } from '@yonailab/levit';
createLevitEditor(el, { plugins: [commentsPlugin({
  onAdd: ({ id, text }, editor) => {},     // a comment was added: store its thread
  onSelect: (ids, editor) => {},           // comments at the caret ([] when none); they are highlighted
  createId: () => crypto.randomUUID(),     // optional; ids must match /^[\w-]{1,64}$/
})] });
editor.commands.addComment();              // on the selection (also the 💬 bubble button)
editor.commands.removeComment(id);
editor.commands.selectComment(id);         // select the comment's text
getComments(editor);                       // [{ id, text, from, to }] in document order
```
Mark: { type: 'comment', attrs: { ids: 'c1 c2' } } (overlapping comments share
it). Not inclusive; left out of HTML and Markdown exports.

## 12. Security
Levit filters unsafe content when it renders, reads pasted HTML/Markdown and
exports HTML: unsafe link and image URLs are dropped (no `javascript:`, no SVG
data URLs), pasted `script`/`iframe`/event attributes are removed, exported
HTML is escaped, and highlighter output keeps only `<span class style>`.
The app must still:
- Validate on the server. Client-side checks can be bypassed: rebuild stored
  content on the server (`documentFromJSON` then `documentToHTML`) or sanitize
  the HTML before showing it to other users.
- Use a Content-Security-Policy, e.g. `script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'`.
  The editor needs no inline scripts or eval.
- Treat plugins, `highlightCode` and `uploadImage` as trusted app code. Escape
  document data (block/mark attrs) you put into plugin `toHTML`, `render` or
  `attributes`, and never put it into `style`, `srcdoc` or `srcset`.
- With collaboration, shared documents and user names come from other users:
  decide who may join a document on the Yjs server, and validate on save.
  Remote names are shown as text and cursor colors must be plain CSS colors.
Releases after the move to Trusted Publishing are published from GitHub Actions
with npm provenance (`npm audit signatures`); 0.4.0 and earlier have none.
Report vulnerabilities privately: https://github.com/azusawa/levit/security/advisories/new
